system.description:
The conjurer learns to invest a summoned object with lasting power, fixing it into the real world so it needs no further concentration to remain.

When you Summon the Simple Form, you may make the item permanent by spending three Blood Traits during the conjuring instead of the usual one. The object is then whole and real, and does not disappear unless banished with Reverse Conjuration. Conjuring itself takes a full turn. Retest with Occult.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
